name: @gcu/markdown
description: The GCU markdown engine: a zero-dependency, regex-free scanner with a source-mapped AST, renderer-rule overrides, and a two-position html toggle (inert by default, no sanitizer ever). Liberal reading grammar, strict authoring lint. One engine for notebook md cells, works surfaces, READMEs, and (eventually) cradle docs and gcu-press typesetting.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
